items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and continue the existing period-aligned finance reconciliation. Amazon reports $4.92 commission, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and 6,219 clicks for 2026-09-21; $4.92 is an aggregate provider row and cannot support site revenue claims. AI usage records $922.38102435 across 5,048 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28, but infrastructure, labor, domain, marketing, commitments, and budget ceilings are not recorded. Contribution margin, cost-to-learn, AI payback, infrastructure burden, budget exposure, forecasts, ROI, and causal lift are therefore unknown. SEO totals of 14,410 impressions, 146 clicks, 1,002 sessions, and 15 conversions are operating metrics, not financial outcomes. Do not create new spend, monetization changes, forecasts, or production work. Complete the existing dated reconciliation using matching-period revenue, attribution, all cost categories, commitments, budget ceilings, and an explicit learning threshold; missing values must remain unknown.

Retain the existing finance reconciliation only. Named provider rows show site-level clicks but zero attributed income in the available window, while the $4.92 aggregate row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. Do not treat zero attributed income as zero total revenue, and do not treat absent costs or budgets as zero. The minimum acceptable artifact is a dated reconciliation of the 18 named tracking rows and aggregate row against matching-period commission, ordered and shipped items, AI spend, infrastructure spend, other operating costs, commitments, budget ceilings, and the learning threshold.

Push back on vanity metrics and unsupported forecasts: the 30-day scorecard has 3 proven outcomes, 41 deployed improvements awaiting measurement, 15 failed implementation requests, and 111 approved proposals without execution. These counts do not establish revenue, margin, payback, or future value. Preserve the current containment decision and release no additional financial capacity until period alignment and cost coverage are evidenced.
